customMethods.name: procedureSelected
openProcedureCategoryEditor
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("openProcedureCategoryEditor() called with %s"%(addMode))

	selection = self.view.custom.procedures.selection['procedureCategoryPaths']
	procedureCategoryId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('procedureCategoryId', system.kanoa.cmms.getProcedureCategory({'procedureCategoryPath': selection[0]})) if len(selection) > 0 else None
	
	params = {'values': {'procedureCategoryId': procedureCategoryId, 'add': addMode}}
	system.perspective.openPopup('Procedure Category Editor', 'kanoa/cmms/config/procedures/procedureCategoryEditor', params)
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteSelected
updateProcedureParent
customMethods.script:
newParentId = droppedItem['procedureCategoryId']
	
	if draggedItem['procedureId'] is not None: # means we've dragged a procedure as opposed to a procedure category
		system.kanoa.cmms.updateProcedureField(draggedItem['procedureId'], 'procedureCategoryId', newParentId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': 'procedure: %s has been moved to a procedure category: %s'%(draggedItem['procedureName'], droppedItem['procedureCategoryName'])})
	else: # means we've dragged a procedure category as opposed to a procedure
		procedureCategoryInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getProcedureCategory({'procedureCategoryId': draggedItem['procedureCategoryId']}))[0]
		procedureCategoryInfo['parentId'] = newParentId
		system.kanoa.cmms.updateProcedureCategory(procedureCategoryInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': 'procedure category: %s has been moved under procedure category: %s'%(draggedItem['procedureCategoryName'], droppedItem['procedureCategoryName'])})
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("updatePopupSelection() message rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	if payload.has_key('msgHandler') and payload['msgHandler'] == 'procedureSelected': 	self.procedureSelected(payload)

	system.perspective.print("updatePopupSelection complete")
	
	return

# implement your handler here
	system.perspective.print('procedureDropped() called with payload: %s'%payload)

#	system.perspective.print("assetDropped() msg rcvd with draggedItem %s | droppedItem %s"%(payload['draggedItem']['assetPath'], payload['droppedItem']['assetPath']))
	procedurePath = payload['draggedItem']['procedurePath']
	if procedurePath is None: return
	
	if not self.view.custom.userAction.canCreate:
		system.perspective.print("User action not allowed. sending refreshTreeSelector() msg")
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.procedures.data')		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'User action not allowed'})
		return
			
	draggedItem = payload['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['droppedItem'] if payload['droppedItem'] is not None else {'parentId': None, 'assetId': None, 'assetPath': 'root level'}

	system.perspective.print("draggedItem['procedureCategoryId'] - %sdraggedItem['procedureId'] - %s droppedItem['procedureCategoryId'] - %s"%(draggedItem['procedureCategoryId'], draggedItem['procedureId'], droppedItem['procedureCategoryId']))
	
	# First handle disallowed drag and drops
	if droppedItem['procedureId'] is not None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', payload={'message': 'Cannot drop a procedure/procedure category onto a procedure.'})
	else:
		self.updateProcedureParent(draggedItem, droppedItem)
	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.procedures.data')
	return

system.perspective.print("confirmMoveProcedure() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	draggedItem = payload['inputPayload']['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['inputPayload']['droppedItem']
	
	if payload['userInput'] == 'OK':

		assetInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getAssets({'assetId': draggedItem['assetId']}),0)
		assetInfo['parentId'] = droppedItem['assetId'] if droppedItem is not None else None
		
		system.perspective.print("Moving %s to parentId %s"%(assetInfo['assetPath'],  assetInfo['parentId']))
		
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.updateAsset(assetInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Asset was not moved. %s'%msg})
		else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Asset has been moved'})
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTreeSelector", {'search': ''})

	self.selectAsset(None)
	self.view.custom.assets.refreshTree = True
	system.perspective.sendMessage('clearTreeSelection', {})

	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')
	
	return
